Unused-expression checker always enables itself; actual executable code is not the stale FIR_EXTRA_CHECKERS comment. It splits lambda from other side-effect-free unused expressions.
Base checks isEnabled and contract bodies, then assigns used/unused states to declarations.
Block last-expression/coercion and loop semantics determine unused states.
Side-effect-free literals, lambdas, references and conservative property-access cases are distinguished from calls/getters/delegates.
Return-value checker excludes side-effect-free expressions already owned by the unused-expression checker; these are not interchangeable IDs.
Common array checker has equality/operator/type conditions, no extra-warning flag check in its body.
Common conversion checker has receiver/type/ambiguity/nullability conditions, no extra-warning flag check in its body.

Real extra/experimental prerequisites, failure/raw/suppression guards, complete model and qualification requirements remain independent.
No frozen cohort, diagnostic oracle, fixture source, budget, historical receipt or catalog default is changed by this evidence.
